read.en: Lumentum rose 5.9% on Oct 27 to $866.18, trading between $820.30 and $892.99. It is above the falling 5-day ($808.7) and 10-day ($829.1) and the rising 200-day ($793.0), just below the falling 100-day ($867.6) and below the falling 30-day ($940.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($908.43), and RSI is 47.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月27日上涨 5.9%，收于 $866.18，盘中区间 $820.30–892.99。股价位于下行的 5 日（$808.7）和 10 日均线（$829.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$793.0）上方，略低于下行的 100 日均线（$867.6），低于下行的 30 日均线（$940.4）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$908.43），RSI 为 47。

read.en: The close cleared $818.9 and $832–841 (Sep 15 low, 10-day, Oct 26 high), now support; the $893 high faded back to the 100-day. Resistance is $867.6–874.7 (100-day, Oct 15 and 19 highs), then $893–897 (Oct 27 and Jul 23 highs) and $908.4 (SAR). Support is $829–841, then $818.9–820.3 and $793–809 (200 and 5-day). A close above $874.7 would target $893–908; below $829, $819.

s.en: 10-day average $829.1; Sep 15 low $832.1; Oct 26 high $840.5, cleared
